rationale: Runs are the campaign's irreducible logical work units: each binds the declared deployment, model, agent, provider details, and deterministic shard/trial membership. Initial waves select shard digests from these runs, but cannot replace the full run definitions.
alternatives: derive from initial_waves: insufficient because wave plans only reference shards and do not retain deployment or trial definitions
merge into initial_waves: conflates logical work definition with scheduling
simplestChoice: Keep `runs` as the required ordered collection of logical run definitions.
